label: Transfer overview to transit security and LAGs re-check
negative_prompt: hard cuts, heavy blur, low quality, distorted text, invented signs, fake QR code, new gate numbers, extra signage, warped illustration, jitter
prompt: Create a smooth 5 second continuous camera glide from the full Hong Kong airport transfer-route overview into the airside Transfer Security frame where every transit passenger goes through a screening lane. Move from the overview toward the security threshold without rotating the camera, preserving the same airport-map orientation and dotted passenger route. Suggest x-ray belts, tray pickup and a liquids re-check counter, but stay illustrative and abstract. clean HKIA-style isometric airport route map, mobile 9:16, white and pale-blue architecture, dark blue dotted passenger route, numbered route markers, premium travel assistant look. Do not add new factual text, gate numbers, flight times, airline logos, retail information, or specific eligibility wording. End exactly on the destination frame composition.
